_about: The base models talkme can call on and train on, one entry each. The app (src/main/config.js), the training pipeline (tune/pipeline.py) and setup (scripts/setup.js) all read this file; the Tune tab's "Add a base model" adds to it. Fields: label (its name in the app); gguf (where the quantized model the app serves goes) and from (the Hugging Face repo that file comes from, same file name); hf (where the full-precision checkpoint the trainer streams goes) and trainFrom (its Hugging Face repo), both only for bases you can train on; format (chat format: gemma4, mistral or qwen3.6); arch (bases with the same arch have the same weight shapes, so they share adapters); ctx (context, when shorter than the app's 32768); historyTicks (how many ticks of a call the model keeps; Gemma 4's tick time grows with the call); expertsOnGpu (no extra experts parked on the CPU to make room for a GPU voice); gpuLayersWithVoice (a dense model too big for a GPU voice beside it: this many layers on the GPU); aliases (other names recipes use for it); note.

qwen.label: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
qwen.note: the first base; recipes call it "original"

hauhau.label: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B, abliterated (HauhauCS)
hauhau.note: no checkpoint to download: tune/hauhau_rebuild.py builds it from Qwen's

gemma4.label: Gemma 4 31B, decensored (heretic)
gemma4.note: dense: ~150 ms a tick near the start of a call, ~550 ms by ~300 ticks on a 4090, so it keeps ~150 ticks (~90 s)

gemma4a4b.label: Gemma 4 26B-A4B, decensored (heretic)
gemma4a4b.note: v1's base; mixture of experts, ~4B active (64 ms a tick near the start, 182 ms later); keeping 8 experts on the GPU, not 15, made Orpheus start sooner (0.97 s vs 1.13 s)

gemma4a4bstd.label: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
gemma4a4bstd.note: the same model as Google released it, not decensored: what a public release builds on

ministral3.label: Ministral 3 14B
ministral3.note: dense 14B; trains from the BF16 release (the plain repo is FP8); keeps ~400 ticks, about what it trained on

gptoss.label: gpt-oss 20B
gptoss.note: proven with Partner v1 (gpt-oss), 2026-11-01; call settings are defaults (ctx 16384, 400 ticks kept), not measured on this model
